## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Note any compatibility, dependency or license impact.

## Local verification

List exact commands, results, platforms and test counts. State what was not run and why.
For Unity work, name the Editor version and distinguish Editor tests from device evidence.
Keep credentials, personal paths and real device identifiers out of logs and examples.
Run `python tools/check_privacy.py` and look at every screenshot: no real project, device, machine, person or address (see AGENTS.md).

## Review and remaining work

Record independent review when required, resolved findings and any remaining limitations.
Do not merge, publish a package or release, or change visibility as part of this pull request.
